 Riot Games and JioBLAST to host VCT 2027 Kickoff South Asia qualifiers 
 By
 TNM (With ANI Inputs) 
 ✓
 4 November 2026, 5:32 pm 
 2 min read
 4 Nov 2026 
 ANI Photo | Riot Games and JioBLAST to host VCT 2027 Kickoff South Asia qualifiers 
 Riot Games has partnered with JioBLAST to organise the VALORANT Champions Tour (VCT) 2027 Kickoff Open Qualifiers in South Asia, where teams will compete for two spots at the Kickoff APAC event.
 The tournament will run from November 17 to 29, with team registration closing on November 13. The competition will feature an Open Qualifier stage followed by Playoffs, with the two highest-ranking teams advancing to the Kickoff APAC.

 The Open Qualifiers, scheduled from November 17 to 20, will use a Swiss-stage format to determine the top eight teams progressing to the Playoffs. The Playoffs will take place from November 23 to 29 in a double-elimination format to select the two qualifying teams.
 This tournament is part of the 2027 VCT season-opening pathway, bringing together both emerging and established teams from across South Asia.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 Charlie Cowdrey, Chief Executive Officer of JioBLAST, stated, “At JioBLAST, we believe the future of esports depends on creating meaningful opportunities for emerging talent to compete, prove themselves and progress to the global stage. It is a great sign to see BLAST’s global relationship with Riot Games extending to India through JioBLAST and it reflects our commitment to strengthening South Asia’s competitive ecosystem and giving teams a clear pathway to pursue their ambitions. We look forward to seeing the region’s best talent step up, compete and seize this opportunity to make their mark.”
 Anushka Bhatnagar, Publishing Lead for Riot Games India and South Asia, added, “The VCT 2027 competitive format marks an exciting step forward in making VALORANT Esports more accessible and creating meaningful opportunities for aspiring players across South Asia. We’re pleased to partner with JioBLAST to bring this opportunity to the region and continue building the competitive ecosystem for VALORANT in South Asia.”
 Teams may register until November 13 at jioblast.com/vctsakickoff. Players must hold a minimum rank of Ascendant 1 and fulfil age, residency, account, and other eligibility criteria as outlined in the official tournament rules.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 The Playoffs will be streamed on the official JioBLAST and VALORANT YouTube channels, as well as on JioTV. Additional information and updates will be available via the official JioBLAST and VALORANT Esports channels.
